title: GPG/PGP key ID
summary: A GPG key ID is a 8 or 16 hex character identifier derived from the key's fingerprint. The short key ID is the last 8 hex chars of the fingerprint; the long key ID is the last 16 hex chars. The fingerprint is the SHA-1 hash of the key packet (20 bytes = 40 hex chars).

notes: Short key ID: last 8 hex chars of fingerprint (32 bits).
Long key ID: last 16 hex chars of fingerprint (64 bits).
Fingerprint: SHA-1 of the key packet (20 bytes = 40 hex chars).
Key IDs are used to identify public keys in key servers and signatures.
Short key IDs are vulnerable to collision attacks (32 bits). Use long key IDs or full fingerprints.
